│ ┌─│Help│───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐ │
│ │ Overview                                                                 │ │
│ │  Overview: repository status and the “Needs you” inbox (items awaiting   │ │
│ │  review, doctor warnings). Enter on a row opens the screen that handles  │ │
│ │  it.                                                                     │ │
│ │  r       Refresh the repository status  bint status                      │ │
│ │          Check the environment (doctor)  bint doctor                     │ │
│ │                                                                          │ │
│ │ Global                                                                   │ │
│ │  q       Quit Bint                                                       │ │
│ │  ?       Show the full help                                              │ │
│ │  :       Open the command palette (search every action)                  │ │
│ │  L       Switch interface language (vi ⇄ en)                             │ │
│ │  !       Read the current notice in full plus the last 50 notices from … │ │
│ │          Turn the mouse on/off for this session (scroll, click tabs, ro… │ │
│ │  ]       Go to the next tab                                              │ │
│ └───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────1–15/180 ↕─┘ │
│                                                                              │
│                                                                              │
└─[r→ Refresh] [:→ Commands] [L→ Language] [q→ Quit] [?→ Help]─────────────────┘
